items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: Red Garland plays like the most amazing blues jazz piano solos. Like perfect and beautiful.

ctx.x: It’s unbelievable. And there’s this blues called “By the Numbers.” Red Garland plays like the most amazing blues jazz piano solos. Like perfect and beautiful. And Coltrane comes in on his solo and plays this one little figure [scats] it’s like a little trill [scats]. It’s obviously not jazz. It’s obviously from another culture. He was invoking another world and that piqued my curiosity. And that one little figure he played led me to explore Middle Eastern music and Eastern European music and then eventually…
That leads me to – this could be a Name that Tune or blindfold test. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-
